GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Went Forward Settled Down Outside Leader .5 Lengths 800m 2nd .5 Lengths home turn 2nd hit lead 200m Kept Going Too Well # on pace/strong win
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Q'd re settling outide leader rdr explained instructred to begin positively and settle in a forward pos. Trnr confirmed general nature of instructions to be positive and had envisaged would settle in first four. Added instructions were similar to those issued at previous starts and was surprised to see settle outside lead. Trainer also exp previous runs this prep had not been without merrit and were in his opinion in stronger races, added mount was third up and in a race that was run to suit.

Jumped Ok well back Settled Down last 8 Lengths 800m Hooked Out 3 Wide 8th home turn 3 Wide 8th widest runner Straight to run on final 200m # back/ran on/further
